inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located 100% on private property, located in public right-of-way, or straddling property lines
inputs.question: Are the five transformer pads shown on the electrical plan located entirely within the property boundary (private property), or do any of them appear to be on or near property lines or in right-of-way areas?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether transformer pads are spatially positioned entirely within the property boundary versus on/near property lines or right-of-way—this requires visual reasoning about the spatial relationship between drawn pad locations and boundary lines, not a precise distance measurement.
